items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: The one source of truth: Tailwind @theme (colors, type, motion, radii) + the CSS names the effects read. A new site = a new copy of this file.

items.name: gsap-setup
items.title: GSAP setup
items.description: Registers ScrollTrigger, SplitText and useGSAP once; every effect imports GSAP from here.

items.name: scroll
items.title: Scripted scroll
items.description: scrollToY: a scripted scroll that glides through Lenis when it runs (SmoothScroll registers it), else the browser's smooth scroll.

items.name: css-units
items.title: CSS lengths in px
items.description: For a layout in rem with a fluid root: remPx, dpx (a design px on this screen) and lengthVar / topbarHeight (a custom property as px).

items.name: preloader
items.title: Preloader
items.description: Five columns, the words of what you do, an honest counter driven by real loading milestones (window.lumeraLoader.step / finish), a column-lift exit that hands over to the hero. Rendered outside hydration.

items.name: roll-text
items.title: RollText
items.description: Each letter rolls up out of sight and its copy rolls in from below, one after another. CSS only; .roll-host on any ancestor triggers it.

items.name: invert-cursor
items.title: InvertCursor
items.description: Inside a scope the pointer becomes a liquid lens that inverts what is under it (difference blend): trails with a lag, its rim ripples, it stretches along its motion and grows in and out softly; bigger over clickables and large type, [data-cursor-size] per area. Mouse only.

items.name: invert-fill
items.title: InvertFill
items.description: Buttons invert from the pointer: a circle of the inverse colour grows from where the pointer came in and shrinks toward where it leaves (.btn--invert); one delegated listener writes --x / --y.

items.name: run-label
items.title: RunLabel
items.description: On hover a button's label runs like a ticker: two copies slide in a loop with faded edges; leaving, it glides to the end of the cycle and stops on the text at rest. (A library variant; the site's buttons use the liquid wave in ui/button.)

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: A gentle pull toward the cursor (mouse only, never with reduced motion); the label lags for depth, presses squash.

items.name: hover-reveal
items.title: HoverReveal
items.description: Over a list row, its picture follows the cursor: lerped follow, lean from the pointer's speed, unmask from the side it came from. After Codrops' Rapid Image Hover Menu (MIT).

items.name: text-fill
items.title: TextFill
items.description: A paragraph whose words light up as you read down (scrubbed). No-break pairs light up as one.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: ScrollReveals
items.description: [data-sr] blocks rise and fade in by batches; [data-split] headings unmask line by line. Touch only fades; a jump shows what it passed at once; focus shows its block.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: Cards light up under the cursor: --mx / --my follow the pointer; the card's CSS draws the light.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.title: SmoothScroll
items.description: Lenis on GSAP's ticker, synced with ScrollTrigger; off for reduced motion and touch; dialogs and [data-lenis-prevent] keep the wheel.

items.name: horizontal-ride
items.title: HorizontalRide
items.description: A pinned horizontal ride, one panel per screen: a wheel gesture (or a sideways swipe) turns one panel, the scroll lands softly on the first and the last, arrows step, skip leaves through a fade and glides on; outlined numerals drift for depth, a HUD counts and names the panels. Selectors are options.

items.name: splash-cursor
items.title: SplashCursor
items.description: Smoke that follows the mouse: a small GPU fluid (WebGL2), knobs as React Bits' <SplashCursor />.

items.name: chrome-wordmark
items.title: ChromeWordmark
items.description: A word in liquid chrome (plain WebGL): domain-warped noise shaded as polished metal, an ivory lens at the cursor.
